notes: Old 11-model Salami kind split: Cacciatore, Finocchiona, Genoa salame, Salame Felino, Salame di Varzi, Soppressata became Italian salame archetypes; Saucisson sec, Salchichón became archetypes of their own kinds; Cervelat handed to Cooked & smoked sausages (06_01), Droëwors to Biltong & droëwors (cured shelf), Landjäger to Kabanos & snack sticks. Old Sobrasada model became an archetype. Teewurst (liver-free raw spreadable) placed here from the cooked shelf. Not confirmed on retrieved pages so left out: ibérico chorizo, Salame Brianza, US meat sticks/Slim Jim, Cantonese vs Hunan styles.
